negative_findings.description: Slovene-language searching for press reports of banks selecting IT/payments vendors ('banka izbrala ponudnika informacijske rešitve', 'javno naročilo') returned no journalistic article naming a bank-vendor award; results drifted to Banka Slovenije corporate pages and the e-JN procurement portal.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero press hits; procurement portal ejn.gov.si surfaced instead as a non-press primary route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-selection intelligence for this cell may be structurally weak — commercial banks are not contracting authorities under public-procurement law, so awards are not gazetted and the press only reports them when a vendor issues a PR. Expect to rely on vendor press releases and Monitor.si rather than daily press.

negative_findings.description: The two highest-value outlets in this cell — Finance.si and the STA wire — are both subscription-gated, and Bančni vestnik full issues sit behind a login ('Prijava' appears in page titles).
negative_findings.result_summary: Headline/teaser layers appear public; full text is not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection design based purely on open crawling will capture the existence of stories but not their specifics, which is exactly where this cell's value lies. Budget for licences or plan a headline-trigger + manual-read workflow.

negative_findings.description: Section URLs for Dnevnik's business desk (https://www.dnevnik.si/posel) and the STAkrog portal (https://krog.sta.si/) were inferred from search-result descriptions rather than confirmed by fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Outlet existence is well evidenced; exact slugs are not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A crawler seeded with an unconfirmed slug will silently return nothing; these two need slug resolution in the verification pass before they count as covered.

negative_findings.description: Slovene banking queries repeatedly pull Banka Slovenije, ECB and even Slovak (National Bank of Slovakia) results — the SI/SK confusion is a persistent noise source in English-language querying.
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple searches returned Slovakia-related entities and central-bank pages instead of press coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must anchor on Slovene-language tokens and .si domains; English 'Slovenia bank' queries are unreliable and cross-contaminate with Slovakia.

coverage_gaps.description: No source found yet for the Primorska/coastal and Gorenjska regional press (e.g. Primorske novice, Gorenjski glas), which would carry local branch closures, savings-bank (hranilnica) news and regional employer/bank disputes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run Slovene queries such as 'Primorske novice banka hranilnica poslovalnica' and 'Gorenjski glas banka' and add confirmed regional titles.

coverage_gaps.description: No investigative/long-form outlet identified (e.g. Necenzurirano, Pod črto, Mladina, Reporter). These are where bank-governance scandals, NPL disposals and political pressure on state-linked banks typically break, and they are absent from the seed list.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Necenzurirano banka', 'Pod črto bančna sanacija', 'Mladina banke' and classify as direct investigative sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Journalist- and analyst-level channels (bylines, LinkedIn/X accounts of Finance.si and Delo banking reporters, podcast/newsletter formats) were not enumerated; these often carry the earliest, pre-publication signals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a byline map from banking articles at Finance.si, Delo and Svet kapitala, then track those journalists' own channels.

coverage_gaps.description: No press-archive or clipping aggregator confirmed for Slovenia (Digitalna knjižnica Slovenije/dLib, Kliping d.o.o., or the skupaj.si clipping pages seen in results), which would enable retrospective baselining rather than forward-only monitoring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate dLib.si for digitised press, and assess commercial clipping vendors for licensed archive access to Finance/Delo/Dnevnik/Večer.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language Slovenian outlets (STA English service, Total Slovenia News, Sloveniatimes) were not enumerated in this pass, though the cell is nominally SL-focused.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add STA's English wire and one or two English Slovenian outlets as cross-check surfaces for items whose Slovene originals are paywalled.

brief: Slovenia's business-press landscape for banking is small, concentrated and heavily gated: Časnik Finance (finance.si, Bonnier-owned, online-only since 2024) is the single highest-yield outlet, with Delo/Gospodarstvo and its Svet kapitala vertical, Dnevnik's business desk and Večer's Moj uspeh forming the second tier, and the state-founded STA wire sitting upstream of nearly all of them. Two industry-adjacent channels materially raise the value of the cell: Bančni vestnik (ZBS's journal since 1952, written by serving bank executives) for stated strategy, and Monitor.si for the back-office IT and payments detail that consumer business press omits. The dominant constraint is access rather than availability — Finance, STA and Bančni vestnik full text all require subscription or login, so a headline-trigger plus licensed-read workflow is more realistic than open crawling, with Delo's STA tag page and Računovodja.com's STA republication as partial free surfaces. The main uncovered ground is investigative long-form (Necenzurirano, Pod črto), regional press, and a retrospective archive route; note also that English-language querying cross-contaminates Slovenia with Slovakia, so Slovene tokens and .si anchoring are mandatory.
